meta.name: remove-ai-slops
meta.description: Removes AI-generated code smells from branch changes or an explicit file list behind regression tests. Use when the user asks to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 清理代码中AI生成的坏味道与冗余痕迹
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常担心AI助手留下的代码不够干净
copy.tagline_en: Clean up AI-generated code smells and redundant patterns in your recent changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often worry about messy code left by AI assistants

howto.what: 该技能会先给分支改动或指定文件中未覆盖的行为补回归测试以锁住现状,再分类清理 AI 生成的代码异味(如多余注释、防御性代码、死代码等),最后跑质量门检查确认没改坏。
howto.when: 当你说“清理”“deslop”或“移除 AI slop”等要求,并指向最近改动时触发,默认处理整个分支 diff,也可传入文件列表。

say.text: 把这次分支改动里的 AI slop 清理一下
say.note: 先补测试再删,行为不变。

say.text: 清理这几个文件的死代码和多余注释
清理这两个文件的过度防御代码,别改行为
say.note: 会先加回归测试锁住现状。

howto.what_en: It adds regression tests to lock behavior, removes AI-generated slop from branch changes or a file list category by category, then runs quality gates.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes; scope is the branch diff or an explicit file list.

say_en.text: Clean up the AI slop in this branch's changes.
Remove dead code and obvious comments from these files.
Clean over-defensive code in these two files, preserve behavior.
